old_caption: The video captures a single airplane flying against a backdrop of a partly cloudy sky. The aircraft, initially appearing dark, leaves a trail of white smoke as it performs an aerobatic maneuver, banking and turning diagonally across the frame. The camera remains static. The plane's color becomes more visible, appearing green and then bright green. It continues its flight path, leaving a continuous smoke trail that follows its banking motion.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dynamic aerial display featuring two airplanes flying against a backdrop of a clear blue sky dotted with scattered clouds. Initially, a green airplane is seen leaving a trail of white smoke as it ascends into the sky. Shortly after, a second airplane, white with black accents, enters the frame from below, flying parallel to the first plane. The two aircraft perform a coordinated maneuver, banking sharply to the right, creating a visually striking formation. As they continue their flight path, the trailing smoke from the green plane forms an elegant arc, enhancing the visual spectacle. The planes maintain their synchronized movement, showcasing precision and skill in their aerial performance. The scene is set under bright daylight, emphasizing the vibrant colors of the planes and the contrasting white smoke against the serene sky.
caption: The video captures a small single-engine propeller aircraft performing an aerobatic maneuver against a pale blue sky scattered with soft clouds. Seen largely as a dark silhouette, the plane continuously emits a white smoke trail that marks the path it has just flown. Throughout the excerpt the aircraft's body orientation rotates steadily within the frame, swinging from a near-vertical, nose-up attitude through a horizontal, nose-right pose, then back through diagonal and vertical angles toward another horizontal attitude. Its position drifts leftward and slightly upward, moving from center-left toward the upper-left region. The smoke trail persists the whole time, its earlier steeply descending curve gradually flattening into a thinner, more horizontal line trailing behind the plane. The far end of the trail shifts out of the left edge. The maneuver remains in progress as the clip ends.
